Package bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.model

Class Customer

java.lang.Object
bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.model.Customer
public class Customer extends Object
Represents a customer in the flight booking system. Each customer has personal information and a list of bookings they have made.
